name: SEO Analysis
description: Scores your pages for SEO and readability against a focus keyphrase, using the open-source YoastSEO.js analysis library, and checks your whole site for SEO and accessibility issues, each traced to the content item and field to fix. Connects to Semrush Site Audit.

configValues.name: siteUrl
configValues.label: Site URL
configValues.description: Your live site, e.g. https://www.example.com. Site Health scans the pages in its /sitemap.xml.

configValues.name: contentSelector
configValues.label: Main content selector
configValues.description: CSS selector for the part of the rendered page to analyze. Defaults to 'main'. Nav, header and footer are excluded automatically.

configValues.name: defaultLocale
configValues.label: Default analysis language
configValues.description: Fallback locale for the analysis when an Agility locale has no matching language, e.g. en_US.

contentItemSidebar.description: SEO and readability analysis for this content item's dynamic page, and the site health issues this item causes.

pageSidebar.description: SEO and readability analysis for this page, and its site health issues.

sections.name: site-health
sections.label: Site Health
sections.description: Every SEO and accessibility issue on your site, grouped by cause and traced to the content item and field to fix.
